text:
Predicates:
Suck(x) ::: x suck.
Vampire(x) ::: x is a vampire.
Vacuum(x) ::: x is a vacuum.
Space(x) ::: x is space.
Duster(x) ::: x is a household appliance that doesn't suck.
Premises:
Plungers suck. ::: Suck(plunger)
Vacuums suck. ::: Suck(vacuum)
Vampires suck. ::: Vampire(vampire)
Space is a vacuum. ::: Space(space) → Vacuum(space)
A duster is a household appliance that doesn't suck. ::: Duster(duster) ∧ ¬Suck(duster)
Conclusion:
Space is a vampire. ::: Space(space) → Vampire(space)
